patch:
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/policy.py b/src/evidence_harness/policy.py
index cb09d9d..63f39c3 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/policy.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/policy.py
@@ -268,8 +268,13 @@ def find_repeated_cycle(
     max_period: int = 3,
     window: int = 20,
 ) -> tuple[str, ...] | None:
+    eligible = [
+        item
+        for item in receipts[-window:]
+        if not (item.mode is CommandMode.OBSERVE and item.repeat_reason)
+    ][-window:]
     signatures = [
-        f"{item.command_fingerprint}:{item.observation_fingerprint}" for item in receipts[-window:]
+        f"{item.command_fingerprint}:{item.observation_fingerprint}" for item in eligible
     ]
     for period in range(1, max_period + 1):
         required = period * repeats
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/protocol.py b/src/evidence_harness/protocol.py
index 6562186..2fcb188 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/protocol.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/protocol.py
@@ -235,6 +235,7 @@ class CommandReceipt(StrictModel):
     purpose: str
     cwd: str | None
     mode: CommandMode
+    repeat_reason: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=500, exclude_if=lambda value: value is None)
     work_epoch: int = Field(ge=0)
     attempt_id: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, exclude_if=lambda value: value is None)
     candidate_digest: Sha256 | None = Field(default=None, exclude_if=lambda value: value is None)
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
index f1a6340..986a08d 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/run_loop.py
@@ -396,6 +396,7 @@ class EvidenceLoop:
             if receipt.succeeded and (
                 receipt.mode is CommandMode.CHANGE
                 or receipt.observation_fingerprint not in receipts_before
+                or (receipt.mode is CommandMode.OBSERVE and bool(command.repeat_reason))
             ):
                 batch_progressed = True
             if not receipt.succeeded:
@@ -753,6 +754,8 @@ class EvidenceLoop:
             work_epoch=state.work_epoch,
             wall_timeout_sec=wall_timeout_sec,
         )
+        if command.repeat_reason is not None:
+            receipt = receipt.model_copy(update={"repeat_reason": command.repeat_reason})
         state.next_sequence += 1
         state.environment_call_count += 1
         state.observations.append(receipt)
